title: micrococca wightii var. genuina
intro: Micrococca wightii var. genuina, commonly known as Jivaka, is a plant species that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. It is known for its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in the treatment of various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Jivaka include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic activities, which can help in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as lowering body temperature. The bioactive constituents of Jivaka include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
